identity.note: Shares the name of the PURE wrestler Radiant (radiant-pure, 2002 to 2003, a puroresu roster card). SFT's home page of 11 July 2003 bills the World Champion by name alone, with no hometown, style or manager to compare, so the records stay distinct until a document ties them.
